subject.title: fix(qqbot): allow approval buttons in direct C2C conversations

question: Which verified QQBot identity may resolve fallback approval buttons in a direct conversation when `execApprovals` is absent?
rationale: The current behavior blocks the reported workflow, but treating every C2C sender as the owner contradicts the established authorization boundary; choosing explicit configuration versus request-bound recipient identity requires maintainer security intent.

options.title: Require explicit approver
options.body: Keep the existing command-authorization gate and require a non-wildcard authorized QQ sender for fallback approval callbacks.

options.title: Bind the request recipient
options.body: Introduce a verified request-time recipient identity and allow only that exact C2C actor to resolve the corresponding callback.

recommendation.title: Require explicit approver
recommendation.body: Keep the existing command-authorization gate and require a non-wildcard authorized QQ sender for fallback approval callbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and proved the current QQBot fallback approval actor boundary and are the strongest feature-history routing candidate.
